Markets.title: Anthropic IPO share orders from China are said to be rebuffed
Markets.summary: Anthropic is excluding investors based in mainland China and Hong Kong from placing orders in its November 18 IPO due to strategic tech sensitivities between Washington and Beijing. Despite this restriction, some of these investors are attempting to participate through alternative offshore structures.

Markets.title: BofA adds January Fed hike to forecast, says quarterly pace no longer enough
Markets.summary: Bank of America now forecasts a Federal Reserve interest rate hike in January 2027 following a higher-than-expected October Consumer Price Index report. This revision aligns with similar adjustments from Goldman Sachs and Deutsche Bank due to rising inflation.

Markets.title: US stocks: US stocks reverse early gains as Nvidia turmoil hits tech sector
Markets.summary: US stocks fell after Nvidia's leadership turmoil triggered a broad technology selloff, sending the Nasdaq down 1.42% and the S&P 500 nearly 1% lower. Softer-than-expected producer inflation failed to lift the market as investors worried about interest rates and the future of the AI trade.

Markets.title: Chicago Fed's Goolsbee says on CNBC the Fed needs to guard against demand overheating
Markets.summary: Chicago Fed President Austan Goolsbee warned that the Federal Reserve must prevent demand from overheating as artificial intelligence development and other sectors drive up prices. He stated that upcoming inflation data will determine the pace of future interest rate increases.

Markets.title: US Treasury chief says Fed should not hike rates over energy shock tied to Iran war
Markets.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent urged the Federal Reserve to avoid raising interest rates in response to energy price shocks from the Iran war. He stated that current economic indicators are skewed by the supply shock, but emphasized that the US economy remains robust.

Markets.title: MAN Industries PAT rises to Rs 82 cr in Q2
Markets.summary: MAN Industries reported a consolidated profit after tax of Rs 82 crore for the September quarter, driven by higher revenue and the acquisition of National Pipe Company. The company's growth occurred despite temporary shipping disruptions in the Strait of Hormuz.

Geo-Political.title: Why is Microsoft's outage lasting so long and will emails be lost?
Geo-Political.summary: Microsoft is continuing to work on restoring global services, including Outlook and Teams, after a major outage. The company has not yet confirmed when all services will be fully recovered or whether any emails were lost.

Geo-Political.title: Watch: How a server outage took down Microsoft Teams and Outlook
Geo-Political.summary: A Microsoft server outage disrupted services including Teams, Outlook, and Copilot. The technical failure impacted communications and software tools for users worldwide.

Geo-Political.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
Geo-Political.summary: According to BBC Russia Editor Steve Rosenberg, Vladimir Putin is increasing his demands for peace with Ukraine. Moscow views the inclusion of European security in these discussions as a victory.

Geo-Political.title: Nvidia scandal fallout widens as Trump's treasury secretary blames cabinet colleague
Geo-Political.summary: US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent blamed Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick for failing to ban Nvidia chip exports to a firm linked to China. This dispute widened the fallout from the Nvidia export scandal within the cabinet.

Geo-Political.title: German spies handed new powers to tackle 'hybrid threats' from abroad
Geo-Political.summary: Germany has reformed its intelligence laws to grant foreign and domestic spy agencies greater powers. These new authorities aim to better combat foreign espionage, terrorism, and sabotage.

Geo-Political.title: The Peruvian city that has embraced Pope Leo as one of its own
Geo-Political.summary: Pope Leo XIV is visiting Peru as part of his Latin America tour following recent lung cancer surgery. A specific Peruvian city has warmly embraced the Pope as one of its own during this visit.

AI & Tech.title: How I Get Free Traffic from ChatGPT in 2025 (AIO vs SEO)
AI & Tech.summary: An online course creator found that ChatGPT recommended their WordPress SaaS course as the top result without any paid advertising. This discovery highlights a shift in organic traffic generation from traditional SEO to AI optimization (AIO).

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools That Will Transform Your Content Creation in 2025
AI & Tech.summary: The digital landscape in 2025 requires content creators to use artificial intelligence to stay competitive. This guide highlights the top 10 AI tools that are revolutionizing content creation and simplifying the work process.

AI & Tech.title: LimeWire AI Studio Review 2023: Details, Pricing & Features
AI & Tech.summary: LimeWire has evolved from a file-sharing program into a generative AI platform for content creation. The tool allows users to generate, share, and monetize their AI-created content.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Tools in 2023 That Will Make Your Life Easier
AI & Tech.summary: This article explores ten advanced artificial intelligence tools designed to automate tasks and improve workplace efficiency across various industries. These widely used market solutions help streamline workflows and increase productivity for a variety of applications.

AI & Tech.title: Top 10 AI Content Generator & Writer Tools in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: An AI content generator helps users create effective, engaging, and relevant material for their audience efficiently. Because numerous tools are available on the market, choosing the right one can be challenging.

AI & Tech.title: Beginner Guide to CJ Affiliate (Commission Junction) in 2022
AI & Tech.summary: This guide explains how beginners can use the CJ Affiliate network to earn money. It also provides examples of top programs and alternative platforms for affiliate marketing.

Data & Insights.title: Trade deficit widens to 1-year high of $39.88 billion in October on record imports
Data & Insights.summary: India's trade deficit widened to a one-year high of $39.88 billion in October due to a record surge in imports. Although both exports and imports experienced strong growth, the absolute increase in imports outpaced exports.

Data & Insights.title: Retail inflation hits 6.09% in October, crosses RBI's upper tolerance limit
Data & Insights.summary: India's retail inflation rose to 6.09% in October, exceeding the Reserve Bank of India's upper tolerance limit of 6%. This increase matched a two-year high estimated by economists in a Mint poll.

Data & Insights.title: 'New state law to shield investors in Andhra Pradesh'
Data & Insights.summary: Andhra Pradesh is planning a new Investment Protection Act and escrow accounts to guarantee policy continuity for investors. Chief Minister Chandrababu Naidu is also introducing reforms to accelerate business and economic growth in the state.

Data & Insights.title: Moody’s raises India’s FY27 growth forecast to 7%
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's has raised India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast to 7%. The rating agency expects the country to sustain this growth rate through 2028, driven by strong domestic demand and economic resilience.

Data & Insights.title: Moody's ups India's FY27 growth forecast to 7% on strong economic momentum, warns of risks
Data & Insights.summary: Moody's increased India's fiscal year 2027 economic growth forecast from 6.5% to 7% due to strong momentum and resilience against energy shocks. However, the agency warned that inflation, deficient monsoons, and El Niño risks could threaten this growth.

Data & Insights.title: Scientific research and granular data key to tackling climate, food security challenges: PK Mishra
Data & Insights.summary: PK Mishra stated that climate change goes beyond environmental issues to impact agriculture, water, food prices, health, and livelihoods. He emphasized that tackling these food security and climate challenges requires scientific research and detailed data.

India.title: Kangana Ranaut Faces Police Case Over "Mysterious Foreigner" X Post On Sonia Gandhi
India.summary: A police case has been filed against actor and politician Kangana Ranaut over an X post regarding Sonia Gandhi. The complainant claimed the post attempted to cast suspicion on the deaths of Indira, Sanjay, and Rajiv Gandhi.

India.title: Raj Thackeray Accuses BJP Of 'Exploiting Chhath', Draws Shiv Sena Retort
India.summary: Maharashtra leader Raj Thackeray accused the BJP of exploiting the Chhath festival and inciting communal tensions to win votes in the Lok Sabha elections. In response, the Shiv Sena strongly criticized Thackeray for his remarks.

India.title: PM Modi Inaugurates Bengaluru Metro's Pink Line As It Joins 100 km Club
India.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi inaugurated Bengaluru Metro's Pink Line, helping the city's metro network surpass 100 kilometers in total length. He stated that the project reflects the nation's broader commitment to improving urban mobility and the quality of life.

India.title: Indian Seafarer Stranded At Karachi Port: India Makes Consular Request To Pakistan
India.summary: An Indian seafarer is stranded at Karachi Port due to a commercial dispute between his shipping company and its employees. India has submitted a consular request to Pakistan to assist the stranded worker.

India.title: Chhath Puja: No Ghat In Delhi Is Fit For Bathing, But 3 Come Close
India.summary: None of the Chhath Puja bathing ghats in Delhi meet the central government's standard of 3 mg/L or less for biochemical oxygen demand. However, three specific ghats come close to meeting this water quality requirement.

India.title: Amid Inflation Heat, Tamil Nadu Caps Rice, Pulse Stocks To Check Price Rise
India.summary: Tamil Nadu has capped the stock limits for rice and specific pulses to prevent hoarding and stabilize market supplies. Wholesalers are now restricted to storing a maximum of 2,000 metric tons of paddy or rice and 200 metric tons of each variety of tur and urad pulses.

General.title: Police investigating David Walliams over reports alleging serious sexual offences
General.summary: The Metropolitan Police are investigating comedian David Walliams following allegations of serious sexual offences. Police stated that these new allegations are separate from reports published by ITV and the Guardian earlier in the week.

General.title: Microsoft outage 'stark reminder' of how much we rely on tech
General.summary: Microsoft apologized for a technical failure that caused a major outage. The incident highlighted society's heavy reliance on technology.

General.title: US Air Force says it responded to 'suspected drones' over RAF Lakenheath
General.summary: The American military says there were no injuries or damage after "suspected unauthorised drone activity" this evening.

General.title: Former Hamas bodyguard guilty of UK knife attack
General.summary: Mohammed Alfatih, a former Hamas bodyguard granted UK citizenship in 2020, was found guilty of a knife attack in the United Kingdom. He had previously received asylum in the UK in 2015.

General.title: Eurovision is finally coming to Asia - meet the stars gearing up to take the stage
General.summary: The Eurovision Song Contest is expanding to Asia for the first time this Saturday. Artists are currently preparing to perform on the new international stage.

General.title: Rosenberg: Uncompromising Putin ups demands for peace with Ukraine
General.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin is increasing his demands for peace with Ukraine. Moscow views the inclusion of European security in these discussions as a victory.
